findings: Only selected stencil bits decrement raw counts, saturating at0. Overlapping sources remain visible while counts are nonzero.
Every cell in the rectangle updates the visibility byte0/255, including unselected bits. Texture row is dimension-1-nativeZ. Cells outside rectangle are preserved.
limits: Region stencil generation, source addition, native GPU upload, smoothing/fade and Map10 providers remain to qualify.
